standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the exact sequence attached to a short exact sequence of complexes, which the proof applies to the periodic complex built out of the differential objects.

core_obligations: The reduction (proof lines 5733-5745): the author writes the short exact sequence of differential objects as a short exact sequence of complexes by repeating it in every degree, with the vertical arrows given by the differentials d, and then applies the cited lemma on long exact cohomology sequences.

The identification of the terms (proof lines 5733-5745): the cohomology of the periodic complex in each degree is the homology of the corresponding differential object, so the exact sequence produced by the cited lemma is exactly the displayed homology sequence.
proof_roadmap: View a differential object as a complex concentrated in a single degree repeated periodically.
Turn the short exact sequence of differential objects into a short exact sequence of such complexes.
Apply the long exact sequence lemma and read off the homology sequence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma associates to a short exact sequence of differential objects a long exact sequence of homology objects (statement lines 5723-5731). The proof is a complete argument: the sequence of differential objects is displayed as a short exact sequence of complexes by repeating it degree by degree with the differentials as the vertical arrows, and the cited lemma on the long exact cohomology sequence of such a sequence is applied to it, the terms being identified as the homology of the differential objects (proof lines 5733-5745). The non-formal content is the conversion of differential objects into periodic complexes. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
